messages:
anya: quick alert — Solstice finetune + LoRA merge then int4 quant shows <unk> in invoice extract. Likely tokenizer mismatch (finetune used spm_v2).

bryce: do we have an example?

anya: INPUT: "Invoice total: $123.45
Line items:"
FP16: "1. Consulting - $100.00"
INT4: "1. <unk> - $100.00"
Token diff: ':' id 58 in fp16 vs id 61 after merge.

li: sounds like id shift. two fixes: remap lora embeddings to base ids or retokenize finetune. remap is faster.

anya: ran rebase script: tools/tokenmap/rebase_lora.py --in lora_solstice.pt --map v2_to_v3.json --out lora_solstice_rebase.pt. can @eval-bot run 200pt solstice_invoice pack against fp16, int4_raw, int4_rebased?

eval-bot: queued run 5091234575: solstice_invoice_200 on merged_solstice fp16, int4_raw, int4_rebased. ETA ~10m.

nate: interim: fp16 EM=0.92, int4_raw EM=0.56, int4_rebased EM=0.85. rebase recovers most but a few rare templates still map incorrectly.

bryce: add gating: block merge if finetune tokenizer != base unless remap provided. also add 50-adversarial templates to pack for OOV catch.

li: will add regression test asserting EM_delta(fp16, int4_rebased) <= 0.05 and draft PR for merge pipeline change.

anya: PR will include repro commands, test vectors, and note for SE onboarding checklist."
